title.narrative: Civil Society Monitoring of CEPA Implementation in Armenia

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the action is to contribute to effective CEPA implementation by civil society.

 The specific objectives of the action are:

1.Monitor and advise the Government on CEPA in selected priority areas.

2. Strengthen the EU-Armenia Civil Society Platform.

3. Increase public awareness of CEPA and its implementation.
